ORAL ORDER 5 05-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned APP for the State.
2.

In this case, the petitioner is seeking regular bail in connection with Chanpatia P.S. Case No. 351 of 2021, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 406, 376, 323, 504,
506 of IPC.
3. As per allegation, the petitioner committed rape upon the informant at the pretext of marriage.
4. The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated.
The victim is a married lady.
She, in her statement recorded under Section 183 of the BNSS
, has stated that her divorce was taken place and she was residing in her hut.
She Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.69715 of 2025(5) dt.05-02-2026 alleged that the petitioner allured her for marriage and committed sexual relation.
He has submitted further that the physical relation between the petitioner and the victim was consensual.

The petitioner is under custody since 09.07.2025.
5.
On the other hand, the learned APP for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner above-named be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Exclusive Special Judge, Rape and POCSO Act, Bettiah, West Champaran in connection with Chanpatia P.S.
